# linear_initiative_labels (Data Source)

List initiative labels and groups with full cursor pagination. Filters match exactly and combine with AND.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_initiative_labels" "groups" {
  is_group = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived labels. Defaults to false.
- `is_group` (Boolean) Filter for groups or ordinary labels.
- `name` (String) Exact name filter.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent group UUID filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this collection.
- `labels` (Attributes List) Matching labels, sorted by UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Hex color.
- `description` (String) Label description.
- `group_type` (String) Group selection behavior, when applicable.
- `id` (String) Label UUID.
- `is_group` (Boolean) Whether this label is a group.
- `name` (String) Label name.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent label group UUID, or null for a root label.
